stem: Under Voltmarkt's convention, an analyst builds a margin bridge by computing the price, cost and volume effects, then setting the mix effect to whatever makes the bridge add up to the change in margin. What is the problem?

options.text: Errors in the other effects end up in mix, so mix is not measured
Mix is defined as the remainder, so this is the standard method
The bridge will no longer add up to the change in gross margin
Mix must be zero whenever total units are the same in both periods
